tools.name: catalog
tools.description: The verified public Registry release catalog with its registryPin.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Compact ranked matches in the verified catalog: default 10, limit 1–12, each exact artifact once. Hits contain id, version, name, short description, lane and get arguments; total counts all matches. Full entries and bytes are available through get. Runs no model.

tools.name: get
tools.description: The checksum-verified bytes of an exact workflow, component or demo version.

tools.name: schema
tools.description: Format check of a workflow YAML with the bundled Q-Core validator. The created-workflow policy of the local Q-Core is not applied. Runs no steps; accepts no secrets.

tools.name: instructions
tools.description: Retired. Returns the current QFactory skill package and verified catalog facts for clients without the QFactory plugin. Input fields other than revision, expectedSha256, section and id are ignored.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "validate" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

confidence.title: Tool description changed since last scan
confidence.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
